recap.paragraph: The final score in Baltimore read 23-20, Chargers! Justin Herbert ran 22 yards for a touchdown. Omarion Hampton ran in for another score. Cameron Dicker’s field goal put Los Angeles up 23-13. Derrick Henry’s touchdown run pulled the Ravens within 3 points. Then the Chargers recovered a crucial fumble by Zay Flowers. Los Angeles earned its first win of the season, ending an 11-game losing run.
